definitions: A web development approach where the initial HTML for a page is generated on the server and sent to the client's browser, rather than being rendered entirely by client-side JavaScript.
A method of delivering web content that prioritizes server-side processing to construct the user interface before any client-side hydration or interactivity occurs.
examples: Many modern frameworks support server-first rendering.
The performance benefits of server-first rendering are significant.
They opted for server-first rendering to improve SEO.
